gen-gf-iansui-fs-plein: Plein reads clean and dependable, with round letters that open clearly. Iansui's hand-drawn heading adds a friendly, personal voice above it, and the pair stays light enough for brief copy.
gen-gf-iansui-fs-recia: Friendly and personal, Iansui writes the heading with flared curve ends and no hairlines in its lowercase a. Recia follows with a serif text whose faint modulation shows only up close, so a longer passage moves along sharp and unfussy.
gen-gf-iansui-fs-spline-sans: Spline Sans sets wide gaps between its curve ends and stems, with vertical and horizontal strokes of identical weight, so it feels contemporary and approachable. Iansui handles warmth; this one handles tidiness.
gen-gf-iansui-fs-synonym: Synonym reads clean, a plain stripe of ink with generous curve openings. Its best quality is the contrast with Iansui's hand-drawn warmth, though it isn't meant for long paragraphs.
gen-gf-iansui-outfit: Iansui looks hand-drawn, friendly and personal. Outfit, a sans-serif, finishes its curves well before they close and keeps every stroke uniform, so the two share a page nicely when the copy stays brief.
gen-gf-iansui-plus-jakarta-sans: Diagonals as thick as the uprights give Iansui a hand-drawn, friendly look with gently flared curve ends. And Plus Jakarta Sans, monoline and precise, supplies the strongest quality here: a crisp, modern foil that suits brief copy.
gen-gf-iansui-sora: Sora is precise and geometric, with no pressure swell at its corners. Its strongest quality is how that crispness sets off Iansui's personal, hand-drawn heading, though it isn't meant for long paragraphs.
gen-gf-iansui-space-grotesk: Constant-width diagonals and gently flared curve ends give Iansui its hand-drawn, friendly look. Space Grotesk answers with open counters and ribbon-like strokes, and the strongest quality is how smoothly they handle brief copy.
gen-gf-iceberg-fs-karma: Karma reads trustworthy and classic, its modulation mild enough never to snag the eye. A touch more size helps it, and Iceberg's marker-tip, wire-like heading letters then stand out boldly above.
gen-gf-iceberg-fs-paquito: Paquito reads confident and approachable, with a very small gap between its x-height and caps. And Iceberg's compass-pencil consistency in the heading gives it bold contrast, which keeps brief copy lively.
